excerpt: You work directly with a dedicated attorney from start to finish. No conflicting answers, no repeating yourself, and a reply within one business day.
We do not use fill-in-the-blank petitions. We learn your accomplishments and craft a case and recommendation letters written for your specific story.
For applicants who qualify, we offer a refund of attorney fees if the case is denied. We'll let you know upfront whether your case qualifies.
Not sure which path fits your background? We help you understand your options and choose the strategy that best showcases your achievements.
The National Interest Waiver lets you petition for a green card on your own when your work serves the national interest of the United States. No employer sponsorship and no job offer required.
We draft your petition, legal brief, and recommendation letters, then file your I-140 with USCIS.
We respond to any requests for evidence at no additional cost.
no employer needs to be involved, there's no job offer to maintain, you're free to change jobs without affecting your case
Once you sign, you're paired with one dedicated attorney and one case manager for your entire case, not a revolving cast of lawyers.
our secure online portal, where you and your attorney can upload and review documents together, communicate directly in one place instead of scattered emails, and track your case status
We open your case file within 24 to 48 hours of receiving your signed agreement.
pay in full (10% discount available) or spread over 14 months at $500/month
We help employers secure H-1B, L-1, O-1, TN, E, and other work visas, providing clear strategy, careful preparation, and steady communication.
We track expirations and plan extensions, amendments, and next steps early, so your employees stay authorized without disruption.
Many employees can change employers through a new petition. We review their status and handle the transfer so they can start with you smoothly.
We guide employers through the annual cap, lottery selection process, and critical filing timelines so hiring plans stay on track.
We guide employers through green card strategy, PERM, and immigrant petitions with clarity and care.
We help you self-audit, fix issues, and build a process so you stay ready for an official review.
we help you prepare and maintain Labor Condition Applications and Public Access Files that meet Department of Labor requirements.
We provide practical training so your internal team knows what to do and when, turning compliance into a routine your organization can own.
Remote work and worksite changes can trigger new obligations. We help you set policies that keep filings accurate as your workforce moves and grows.
Ellis Porter helps researchers, founders, physicians, engineers, artists, and other exceptional professionals build a clear path to living and working in the United States.
